semibarbarian.definition:
a. Half barbarous; partially civilized.
n. One partly civilized.
semibarbarian.translation:
a. 半野蛮的
n. 半野蛮的人

semibarbaric.definition:
a. Half barbarous or uncivilized; as, semibarbaric
   display.

semibarbarism.definition:
n. The quality or state of being half barbarous or
   uncivilized.

semibasement.translation: n. (部分低于地面的)半地下室

semibenzene.translation: 半苯, 对二烷基亚甲基环己二烯

semibrachiation.translation: n. [动]半臂跃(指某些猿的行进方式)

semibreve.definition: n a musical note having the longest time value (equal to four beats in common time)

semibreves.definition: n. a musical note having the longest time value (equal to four beats in common time)
semibreves.translation: n. 全音符( semibreve的复数形式 )

semibright.translation: 半光亮的, 半光泽的

semibull.definition:
n. A bull issued by a pope in the period between his
   election and coronation.
semibull.translation: n. [宗]准诏书(教皇于选任后加冕前颁布,只盖一半玺印)
